definitions.gloss: three-person discussion; three-way conversation; trilateral talk
definitions.explanation: A formal discussion or conversation among exactly three people. Often used for published interviews or panel discussions featuring three participants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{鼎談|ていだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A three-way discussion among three experts was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鼎談|ていだん}⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A three-person discussion article was published in the magazine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{編集者|へんしゅうしゃ}→編集者：09587_henshuusha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批評家|ひひょうか}→批評家：19430_hihyouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鼎談|ていだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: A project where an author, editor, and critic have a three-way discussion is gaining popularity.

notes:
The character {鼎|てい} refers to a three-legged bronze vessel from ancient China, hence the association with the number three. This word specifically implies exactly three participants, unlike {座談|ざだん} which can have any number.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鼎談|ていだん}⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧: three-person discussion article
- {鼎談|ていだん}⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧: three-way discussion project
- {鼎談|ていだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a three-person discussion
- {鼎談|ていだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a three-person discussion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対談|たいだん}→対談：19950_taidan⟧: dialogue; conversation between two people — specifically two participants
- {座談|ざだん}: round-table discussion — any number of participants
- ⟦{座談会|ざだんかい}→座談会：12549_zadankai⟧: round-table discussion meeting — a more common general term for group discussions
- ⟦{討論|とうろん}→討論：05100_touron⟧: debate; discussion — formal discussion with opposing viewpoints
